apply_multi_apply: apply a function to multiple lists of arguments and transpose the results into grouped lists
unmap_tensor_data: unmap a subset of tensor data back to the original set using index mapping and fill values
convert_mask_to_ndarray: convert BitmapMasks, PolygonMasks, or torch.Tensor masks into numpy ndarray format
review_multi_apply: review the multi_apply function that applies a callable to multiple input lists and transposes outputs
test_unmap: test the unmap function to verify it correctly places data back into a full-sized tensor using indices
